lines.text: Chat answers sooner and stays ready for 45 minutes after your last message; it no longer refuses a reply for style.
Settings › The mind has the page that says how I talk. Edit it there; if I change it, I say so in chat.
I now leave you a morning note, and one or two check-ins a day in chat or on home. No notifications from me.
Looking something up no longer stops me saving what you tell me, setting reminders or placing Muse orders.
